The script explicitly forbids this.

The final render (and the contact sheets) lay those pages out like the rr-sheet frames, so ch04-s01, ch04-s02 and ch04-s03 all show the wrong region or bracket the wrong element.
issues.fix: Make RrwebScreen restore the sheet scroller's scroll state deterministically on a single seek (replay scroll events up to `at`), or revert these shots to the rr-sheet-measured CROPS in sets/takes.ts. Then verify every product crop and overlay on frames pulled from render/film.mp4 with ffmpeg, never on a harness DOM probe.
